title: Extrusion fountains are hallmarks of chromosome organization emerging upon zygotic genome activation.
authors: Galitsyna, Aleksandra; Ulianov, Sergey V; Bazarevich, Mariia; Bykov, Nikolai S; Veil, Marina; Gao, Meijiang; Perevoschikova, Kristina; Gelfand, Mikhail S; Razin, Sergey V; Mirny, Leonid; Onichtchouk, Daria
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过Hi-C和聚合物模拟研究ZGA期间染色体组织中的fountain结构，涉及cohesin加载与环挤压机制，虽非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但增强子激活与转录因子敲除关联及环挤压模拟对TF-DNA互作机制研究有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: The initiation of gene expression during development, known as zygotic genome activation (ZGA), is accompanied by massive changes in chromosome organization. However, the earliest events of chromosome folding and their functional roles remain unclear. Using Hi-C on zebrafish embryos, we discovered that chromosome folding begins early in development with the formation of "fountains", a novel element of chromosome organization. Emerging preferentially at enhancers, fountains exhibit an initial accumulation of cohesin, which later redistributes to CTCF sites at TAD borders. Knockouts of pioneer transcription factors driving ZGA enhancers result in the specific loss of fountains, establishing a causal link between enhancer activation and fountain formation. Polymer simulations demonstrate that fountains may arise as sites of facilitated cohesin loading, requiring two-sided but desynchronized loop extrusion, potentially caused by cohesin collisions with obstacles or internal switching. Moreover, we detected similar fountain patterns at enhancers in mouse cells. Fountains disappear upon acute cohesin depletion, as well as during mitosis, and reappear with cohesin loading in early G1. Altogether, fountains represent the first known enhancer-specific elements of chromosome organization and constitute starting points for chromosome folding during development, likely through facilitated cohesin loading.
abstract_zh: 发育过程中基因表达启动，即合子基因组激活（zygotic genome activation, ZGA），伴随着染色体组织的巨大变化。然而，染色体折叠的最早事件及其功能作用仍不清楚。通过对斑马鱼胚胎进行Hi-C分析，我们发现染色体折叠在发育早期即开始，并形成“喷泉”（fountains），这是染色体组织的一种新元素。喷泉优先出现在增强子处，表现出cohesin的初始积累，随后cohesin重新分布至TAD边界的CTCF位点。驱动ZGA增强子的先锋转录因子敲除导致喷泉特异性丢失，确立了增强子激活与喷泉形成之间的因果联系。聚合物模拟表明，喷泉可能作为cohesin加载的促进位点出现，需要双向但不同步的环挤压，这可能是由cohesin与障碍物碰撞或内部切换引起的。此外，我们在小鼠细胞的增强子处检测到类似的喷泉模式。在急性cohesin耗竭及有丝分裂期间，喷泉消失，并在早期G1期随cohesin加载重新出现。总之，喷泉代表了已知的首个增强子特异的染色体组织元素，并构成发育过程中染色体折叠的起点，可能通过促进cohesin加载实现。
